manual.summary: Icon is only an image: `onclick` and `tabindex` are gone, a clickable icon is a Button.
manual.action: Replace the Icon with `<Button buttonType="text" icon={mdiX} aria-label="..." onclick={...} />` (Button from the library). Move its variables to the Button: `--icon-size` → `--button-icon-size`, `--icon-color` → `--button-color`, `--icon-hover-color` → `--button-hover-color`, `--icon-container-height` / `-width` → `--button-height` / `--button-width`. Check handlers that read `e.key` or the `<span>` as `e.currentTarget`. If the icon sits inside another clickable element (a row, a card), check that the click does not also trigger it.

manual.summary: Icon renders an `<svg>` sized by `--icon-size` (default `1em`) and filled with `--icon-color` (default `currentColor`) instead of a `<span class="icon mdi ...">` font glyph; without `title` it is hidden from screen readers.
manual.action: Rewrite app CSS that targets `.icon`, `.mdi` or the `::before` glyph of an Icon (`font-size` → `--icon-size`, `color` → `--icon-color`, or pass `class`). Where the icon alone carries meaning (a status icon with no text next to it), pass `title`.

manual.summary: MDI helper classes (`mdi-spin`, `mdi-rotate-*`, `mdi-flip-*`, `mdi-18px`, `mdi-24px`, `mdi-36px`, `mdi-48px`, `mdi-light`, `mdi-dark`, `mdi-inactive`) do nothing: the MDI webfont CSS is not loaded.
manual.action: Remove them from `name` and `class`. Sizes → `--icon-size`; colors and opacity → `--icon-color`; spin, rotation and flip → an app class with `animation` or `transform`, passed through `class`.

added: `title`: accessible name (role `img`); without it the icon is decorative.

toCssVar.name: width
toCssVar.note: Default `fit-content`.

toCssVar.name: menuWidth
toCssVar.note: v4 drew a 60px column of icons; the list is now a grid of tiles as wide as its columns (`columns`, default the number of options up to 5). Drop the prop unless a fixed width is wanted.

defaults.name: values
defaults.note: With `bind:values` on an uninitialized variable, the variable stays `undefined` until something is selected: initialize it to `[]` where the app reads `values[0]`.

types.name: items
types.note: `IconItem` is exported from the package root: drop local copies of the type. `label` is required and `icon` is an SVG path: see the manual step `icons-dropdown-items`. `values` has the same type.

changed.name: onchange
changed.type: { select?: IconItem<Data>; unselect?: IconItem<Data>; selection: IconItem<Data>[] }
changed.note: Picking another icon now also reports the replaced one in `unselect`. The usual `e.detail.selection[0].value` becomes `e.selection[0].value`.

manual.summary: Every option needs a `label`, its accessible name, Tooltip and type-ahead text (v4 options had no text at all), and `icon` is an SVG path (v4: an MDI class name).
manual.action: Add a short `label` to each object in `items` and `values` (for example "Paragraph", "Heading 1", "Align left", in the language of the app) and apply the global icon transform to every `icon` (`"mdi-format-header-1"` → `mdiFormatHeader1` from `@mdi/js`). Also pass `label` to the component to name the button ("Text style", "Alignment"): without it screen readers hear "Select".

manual.summary: The button shows the chosen icon in a gradient tile and is as tall as a Button of the same `size` (md 34px); the list is a grid of 36px tiles (chosen one with the gradient, highlighted one tinted) with a Tooltip on the highlighted tile. v4 drew a plain button and a 60px column of 20px icons.
manual.action: Check editor toolbars and other places where the dropdown sits next to buttons. `--icons-dropdown-value-*` restyles the tile in the button, `--icons-dropdown-option-*` the tiles of the list, `columns` the grid.

manual.summary: The v4 overrides on the inner Dropdown no longer fit: `--button-padding` now replaces the padding tuned around the tile, `--button-width` has no effect on this button, and `--autocomplete-selected-item-color` does not reach the tiles.
manual.action: Remove `--button-width` and `--button-padding` from the IconsDropdown (use `--icons-dropdown-padding` only if the default padding does not fit). Replace `--autocomplete-selected-item-color` with `--icons-dropdown-option-selected-color` and `--icons-dropdown-option-selected-background`, or drop it to keep the theme look.

manual.summary: With `clearable` the clear X is a separate button ("Clear selection") shown in place of the arrow, hidden while `disabled`; in v4 it was an icon inside the button that also cleared a disabled dropdown.
manual.action: Check flows that cleared a disabled IconsDropdown.

added: `label`: accessible name of the button and title of the mobile drawer, not shown.
`multiple` with `maxVisibleIcons` (tiles in the button, then "+N"), `mandatory`, `closeOnSelect`.
`columns` of the grid; the four arrows move through it, a letter jumps to the first label that starts with it.
Everything from `Dropdown`: `placement`, `mobileDrawer`, `variant`, `size`, `name`, `bind:open`, `bind:buttonElement`, `locale`, `selectionText`, `onclose`, `class` per part (plus `tile`).
Snippets `valueSnippet`, `itemSnippet`, `chevronSnippet`, `clearSnippet`, `emptySnippet`.
`--icons-dropdown-*` variables for the button padding, the tiles in the button and in the list, the grid gap and the menu width.

changed.name: data
changed.note: Same shape as the chart.js `data`: `{ labels, datasets }`, and chart.js dataset keys still work. Svelte state can be passed as it is: remove `$state.snapshot(...)`. New library keys per series: `color` (any CSS color, also `var(--…)`; an array gives one color per point) instead of `backgroundColor`/`borderColor`, `axis: 'right'` instead of `yAxisID`, `area` instead of `fill`, `dashed` instead of `borderDash`, `format` for the values of that series. Keys that only repeated the old defaults are no longer needed: `tension`, `fill: false`, `borderWidth`, `borderRadius`, `maxBarThickness`.

changed.name: options
changed.note: Still chart.js options, merged over the defaults of the library (no longer mutated). The common ones are props now (`horizontal`, `stacked`, `format`, `legend`, `zoom`): see the `-options` step. Optional in v5.

changed.name: width
changed.note: Native attributes (`width`, `height`, `class`, `style`, `id`) go to the root `<div>`, no longer to the `<canvas>`. Size the chart with `--bar-chart-width` / `--bar-chart-height` (same names with `line-chart` and `pie-chart`).

removed.name: resetZoom
removed.note: While zoomed the chart shows its own "Reset zoom" icon in the top-right corner of the plot, and a double click also resets. Remove `bind:resetZoom` and the reset button of the app. To reset from code, `bind:chart` and call `chart.resetZoom()`.

manual.summary: `$state.snapshot(...)` around `data` is no longer needed: the chart copies the values itself.
manual.action: Pass the `$state` / `$derived` data directly: `data={$state.snapshot(chartData)}` → `data={chartData}`.

manual.summary: Colors follow the theme and dark mode by themselves: the code that read the v4 tokens by hand for the canvas is no longer needed.
manual.action: Look in the component for `getComputedStyle(...).getPropertyValue('--global-color-…')`, `readToken`, `rgb(${...})` strings built from the v4 triplets, effects or `if ($theme.dark)` that exist only to recolor the chart, and `hsl(i * N, …)` palettes. Remove them: series without `color` take the data palette of the theme (`--global-color-data-1…6`, one series alone gets the brand gradient); where a specific color matters, write `color: 'var(--global-color-…)'` with the v5 token of the same role (see Color tokens in MIGRATION.md). One color per point: an array in `color`.

manual.summary: Props of the v3 charts (`xTickLabel`, `enableZoom`, `yMin`, …) did nothing in v4: they ended up as attributes of the canvas, so the chart was drawn with the defaults. The codemod removes the ones with nothing to keep (`showXTicks`, `pointRadius`, `rgbTooltipColor`, …).
manual.action: Delete them, or give them the meaning the app wanted: `enableZoom` → `zoom` (`zoom={false}` turns zooming off, which v4 never did); `xTickLabel`/`yTickLabel` that format numbers → `format`; `xMin`/`xMax`/`yMin`/`yMax` → `options={{ scales: { y: { min, max } } }}`. `horizontal` is a prop again and keeps working.

manual.summary: Global chart.js tweaks of the app (`Chart.defaults.…`, `Chart.register(...)` of an app plugin) were made for the v4 charts.
manual.action: Remove `Chart.defaults.resizeDelay` and plugins registered only to fix the hover of horizontal bars (`interaction.axis` follows `horizontal` now). Keep the app’s own chart.js charts, if any, as they are.

manual.summary: Most `options` the apps pass are props or defaults now; what is left stays in `options`.
manual.action: Move and delete, then keep in `options` only what is left: `maintainAspectRatio: false` → delete (the chart fills `--line-chart-height`, 16rem; write `--line-chart-height="100%"` to fill a widget that has a height); `scales.*.ticks.display: true` → delete (visible by default); `ticks.callback: (v, i) => labels[i]` → delete; tick and tooltip callbacks that only format numbers (`toLocaleString`, `Intl.NumberFormat`, `€`, `%`) → `format` (options of `Intl.NumberFormat`: axes get the short form by themselves) or the series `format`; `plugins.legend.display: false` → delete (`legend="auto"` shows it only with two or more series) or `legend={false}`; `plugins.legend.position` → `legend="top|bottom|right"`; `interaction: { intersect: false }` → delete; `plugins.zoom` → delete, or `zoom={false}` to turn zooming off; `plugins.tooltip.callbacks.label` returning `"label: value"` → the tooltip shows the series name by itself, so return only the value, or use `tooltipSnippet`. `scales.y.stacked: true` → `stacked`; a second axis (`yAxisID` plus a scale with `position: "right"`) → `axis: "right"` and `format` on the series; `elements.point.radius` → delete (points appear on hover); `elements.line.borderWidth` → `--line-chart-line-width`.

manual.summary: v5 draws the lines like the design prototype: smooth curves, points only on hover with a vertical guide, ticks on both axes (v4 hid them), legend below and only with two or more series, HTML tooltip card; one series alone gets the brand gradient and a glow.

keys.note: The column manager cannot hide it, as in v4.

nested.note: `string` is the default text column; `number` is now formatted and right-aligned; `date` shows day, month and year in digits in the language of `locale` (`dateFormat` for Intl options), `datetime` also the time; `icon` and `checkbox` are gone (draw them with a `cell` snippet)

items.note: each header becomes a column: `value` → `key`, `type: { key, params }` → a flat `type` (`string` → none, `number`, `date` or `datetime`, `boolean`, `custom`), `params.nullText` → `empty`, `locked` → `required`, `sortModify` → `sort` with `{ builder, direction }`; `icon` and `checkbox` columns are gone (use a `cell` snippet), `data` is gone

manual.summary: `headers` become `columns`: `value` → `key`, `type: { key, params }` → a flat `type` and options. `string` → `text` (or no type), `number` → `number` (now formatted and right-aligned), `date` with a luxon `format` → `date` or `datetime` with `dateFormat` (Intl options, language from `locale`), `custom` stays `custom`, `icon` and `checkbox` are gone (they ignored the value). `nullText` → `empty` (also when it was a function: use `format` or `cell`), `sortModify` → `sort` with `{ builder, direction }` instead of `{ builder, sortDirection }`, `minWidth`/`maxWidth`/`width` accept any CSS length, `pinned` stays, `locked` and `data` are gone.
manual.action: Rewrite each header object. A `date` column with `{ format: 'dd/MM/yyyy', locale: 'it' }` usually needs no options: the default is day, month and year in digits in the language of `locale`; luxon values still work. Remove `icon` columns or draw the icon with a `cell` snippet. Where a header had `width` in %, keep it: it is a preferred width; use `minWidth` when the column must not shrink.

manual.summary: `customSnippet` (now `cellSnippet`) usually holds a chain `{#if header.value == 'a'} … {:else if header.value == 'b'} …`. It keeps working with `column.key`, but every column can carry its own `cell` snippet, and formatting that v4 apps did by hand is now built in: dates (`type: 'date'`), money (`type: 'number', numberFormat: { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }`), yes/no (`type: 'boolean'`), empty text (`empty`).
manual.action: The codemod renames the parameters (`header` → `column`, `item` → `row`, `header.value` → `.key`). Then, branch by branch, replace hand-made formatting with the column type, and move the remaining branches to top-level snippets referenced by `cell` in the column definition; delete `cellSnippet` when it is empty.

manual.summary: About half of the row click handlers only navigate (`goto('/x/' + item.id)`). `rowHref` makes the row a real link: Ctrl-click and middle click open a new tab, SvelteKit preloads it, keyboard and screen readers reach it.
manual.action: Where `onrowClick` only calls `goto(url)`, replace it with `rowHref={(row) => url}`. Keep `onrowclick` for actions that are not a page (opening a dialog, selecting).

manual.summary: Above 200 rows (`virtualize`) only the rows in view, plus a margin, are in the page; the others are drawn while scrolling and the columns keep the widths of the first rows. The find of the browser (Ctrl+F) and printing see only the drawn rows.
manual.action: Usually nothing to do. Where a page must show every row in the DOM (printing, Ctrl+F on long lists, tests or scripts that query all the rows), pass `virtualize={false}`, or a higher threshold such as `virtualize={1000}`.

manual.summary: v4 split one query in three callbacks (`onpaginationChange`, `onfiltersChange`, `onsort`) whose bodies were almost the same (load the page with `{ page, perPage, filtersBuilder }`), never reset the page and dropped the search from the builder of a page change. v5 has one `onquerychange(query)` with `{ page, pageSize, sort, search, filterValue, builder }`, the page already back to 1 after a change of filters, search, sorting or page size.
manual.action: Replace the handlers with one `onquerychange={(query) => load(query)}` that calls the service with `query.page`, `query.pageSize` and `query.builder`, then sets `rows`, `total` and `loading`; delete `page = 1` resets and the `filtersBuilder` kept in the page. Better, replace the whole thing with a `loader` (see `data-table-loader`).

manual.summary: With `loader={(query) => service.list(...)}` returning `{ rows, total }` the table loads by itself: loading state, aborted outdated requests, error with "Retry", page past the end, `reload()` after a create or delete. The first page from the `load` of SvelteKit goes in `rows` and `total`, so it is not loaded twice.
manual.action: Write `loader={async ({ page, pageSize, builder, signal }) => { const res = await service.list({ page, perPage: pageSize, filtersBuilder: builder }, { signal }); return { rows: res.data, total: res.meta.total }; }}` (or `pageCount: res.meta.lastPage`), pass `rows={data.rows}` and `total={data.total}` from `load`, and delete the handlers, `loading` and `maxPage` state. Call `table.reload()` (with `bind:this={table}`) where the page reloaded the list after saving.

manual.summary: `filters` (v4 `Filter[]`, definition and value together) becomes `filterFields` (`FilterField[]`, definitions only) plus `bind:filterValue` (the tree of conditions, as the `value` of Filters).
manual.action: Convert each `Filter` to a `FilterField` as the Filters rule says (`filters-fields`); where the page read the active values from `filters`, read `filterValue` (or `query.filterValue`) instead. Initial conditions go in `filterValue={createFilters([filterCondition(...)])}`.

manual.summary: The quick filters of the v4 tables (two incompatible models in PaginatedTable and DynamicTable) are fields of the Filters: `pinned` keeps a field as a pill in the bar, `presets` are chips with ready conditions. A "missing value" is the operator `empty`; a boolean with three states is `isTrue` / `isFalse` / no condition.
manual.action: For each quick filter add `pinned: true` to its field in `filterFields`; for ready-made choices pass `filtersProps={{ presets: [{ id, label, conditions }] }}`. Move the `modify` of custom quick filters to the `apply` of the field.

manual.summary: The selection keeps working across pages and has one model: `bind:selected`, plus `selectedAll` and `excluded` once the user picks "Select all N" in the bar (v4 PaginatedTable could not exclude rows and cleared `selectedItems` at every page). It is cleared when filters or search change. The header checkbox selects the rows of the page (v4 PaginatedTable: every row). The v4 `Action` objects keep working as `selectionActions`.
manual.action: Rename `actionsForSelectedItems` to `selectionActions` and, in each `onClick`, read the selection from the argument (`onclick: ({ selected, selectedAll, excluded, event }) => ...`) instead of the bound `selectedItems`; when `selectedAll` is true send the query (`builder`) and `excluded` to the backend instead of the ids. Destructive actions can take `variant: 'danger'`. Where the bar must not show, pass `selectionBar={false}`.

manual.summary: Apps saved the visible headers as `[{ name, order }]` in the user settings (`populateHeaders`, 53 times). v5 keeps the order, visibility, widths and pins as `columnState` = `[{ key, visible, width?, pinned? }]`, plain data.
manual.action: Keep the setting key and store `columnState` instead: restore it with `columnState={settings.value}` (old values: map `[{ name, order }]` to `{ key: name, visible: true }` in order, the others hidden) and save it in `oncolumnstatechange({ columnState })`, called when the user saves the view or resizes a column. Delete `populateHeaders` and the hand-made column drawers.

manual.summary: Many apps wrap the v4 tables (`StandardPaginatedTable`, `<Entity>PaginatedTable`, a `PaginatedTable` with `fetcher` in evote and epass, `LocalPaginatedTable` in lupette) mostly to repeat the same fetch, the same defaults (`lang="it"`, `editFilterMode`) and the same column drawer.
manual.action: Migrate the wrapper once to `DataTable` with a `loader`, then check whether it still adds anything: set `setDefaultLocale('it')` in the root layout instead of `lang`, and use `columnManager` instead of the copied drawer. For rows already in memory (LocalPaginatedTable) use `Table` with `Paginator`: DataTable always asks the server.

manual.summary: Default look of the prototype: one bordered box with the toolbar on top (search, filter pills, "Columns", the app buttons on the right), the table and a footer with "Rows per page", "1–20 of 312" and the paginator; the selection bar floats at the bottom of the table. Below the `cardBreakpoint` of the table the frame goes away and the rows become cards.
manual.action: Usually accept it. Remove page CSS that drew a box or a toolbar around the v4 table. App CSS on `.paginated-table`, `.searchbar-and-filter-container` or `.footer` must target `.aurora-data-table`, `.aurora-data-table-toolbar`, `.aurora-data-table-footer` or use the `class` parts.

added: `loader({ ...query, signal })` with `onloaded`, `onerror`, `errorSnippet` and `reload()`.
`pagination`: `pages`, `infinite` (with `onloadmore` when there is no `loader`) or `none`.
`search` bindable, `searchable`, `filterValue` bindable, `filtersProps`, `searchBarProps`, `paginatorProps`, `columnManagerProps`.
`columnManager`: "Columns" button with the `ColumnManager`; `oncolumnstatechange` on save and resize.
Selection bar with "Select all N", `selectionActions` (with `variant: 'danger'` and promises that spin), `selectionDisabled`, `selectionActionsSnippet` for extra content, `selectionBar`, `excluded`.
`pageSizes`, `pageCount`, `rangeSnippet`, `searchSnippet`, `toolbarSnippet`, `labels`, `class` parts (`container`, `toolbar`, `footer`, `selectionBar`, `table`, `header`, `row`, `cell`).
`--data-table-*` variables for the frame, the toolbar, the footer, the messages and the selection bar.
Every prop of `Table`: `expandedSnippet`, `rowHref`, `actionsSnippet`, `actionsVisibility`, cards, `columnState`, `columnsKey`.

manual.summary: The days of a period changed: `this-month` and `this-year` run to the end of the month or year and `this-week` starts on Monday (as the backends did); `last-3month` and `last-6month` are exactly 3 or 6 months counting today (the backends started on the first day of the month 2 or 5 months ago); a rolling period counts today, "last 7 days" are today and the 6 days before (v4 and the backends counted 8). v4 computed yet other days on the client.

manual.summary: Backends must resolve `rolling` periods and the `last-3month` / `last-6month` presets as the library does now, counting today, or the app and the server show different days.
manual.action: In the backend helpers that turn the value into dates (for example `getFiltersFromTimespanRollingMethod` and `getFiltersFromTimespanQuickMethod` with luxon): start "last N" at `today.minus(duration).plus({ days: 1 }).startOf("day")`, end "next N" at `today.plus(duration).minus({ days: 1 }).endOf("day")`, start `last-3month` at `today.minus({ months: 3 }).plus({ days: 1 }).startOf("day")` and `last-6month` at `today.minus({ months: 6 }).plus({ days: 1 }).startOf("day")`. Tooltip callbacks that format numbers → `format`. A total drawn by the app in the middle (an absolutely positioned element over the canvas) → the built-in total with `centerLabel`, or `centerSnippet`. Click handlers in `options.onClick` with `getElementsAtEventForMode` → `onitemclick`.

manual.summary: v4 gave every SearchBar the fixed id `search-content` and an `aria-labelledby` pointing to itself: duplicate ids and a field with no accessible name. v5 names the field and the `role="search"` landmark with `label`, else `aria-label`, else the placeholder.
manual.action: Give each usage a `label` that says what it searches ("Search clients"), especially when the placeholder is missing or is an example ("Mario Rossi"). Remove app code and tests that relied on `#search-content`: use `bind:input`, an `id` (forwarded to the input) or `getByRole("searchbox", { name })`.

manual.summary: `onsearch(text)` fires `debounce` ms (300) after the last keystroke, at once on Enter, on the search button and when the field is emptied. v4 apps and the v4 tables debounced `oninput` themselves (PaginatedTable `searchTimeoutDelay` 300; DynamicTable 800 ms plus Enter).
manual.action: Replace the app debounce (`clearTimeout` / `setTimeout` in `oninput`, `debounce` store, Enter handled in `onkeydown`) with `onsearch={(text) => ...}`. Keep the v4 delay with `debounce={800}` where the app used it; `searchOnType={false}` searches only on Enter and the button. Show `loading` while the results arrive. Leave `oninput` only for work that must run at every keystroke.

manual.summary: The input is `type="search"`: Enter calls `onsearch` and no longer submits the surrounding form, Escape with text empties the field (Escape on an empty field still reaches dialogs and menus).
manual.action: Check `onkeydown` handlers that handled Enter or Escape: delete them when they only started or reset the search (`onsearch` does it), or call `event.preventDefault()` in them to keep the app behaviour. A SearchBar inside a `<form>` that relied on Enter to submit needs a submit in `onsearch`.

manual.summary: With `inputSnippet` the app input replaces the built-in one, so it gets none of its behaviour: debounce, `onsearch`, Enter / Escape, the accessible name.
manual.action: Bind the app input to the same `value` (`bind:value` on both) so the clear button and `data-filled` follow it, give it an accessible name, and call the search from its own events; or drop the snippet and use the built-in input with native attributes, which are now forwarded.

manual.summary: New look: 40px field on the theme input tokens (border, radius, font, hover and focus ring), an 18px MDI magnifier, a clear button while there is text; v4 was a 48px grey bar with a 1px ring.
manual.action: Usually accept it; for the v4 height set `--search-bar-height="3rem"`. The v4 input attributes `maxlength="512"`, `aria-autocomplete="both"` and `tabindex="0"` are gone: pass `maxlength` if the app relied on it. App CSS on `.search-bar-container`, `.search-icon`, `.input` → `.aurora-search-bar`, `.aurora-search-bar-icon`, `.aurora-search-bar input` (or the `class` parts).

`locale` (BCP 47): language of the default texts, Italian with `it`, English otherwise; without it the one of `setDefaultLocale` (step `global-default-locale`), else `en`. Text props win over it.
`buttonLabel` (a search button) and `buttonSnippet({ search })`.
Native `<input>` attributes forwarded (`id`, `name`, `maxlength`, `aria-*`, ...).
`data-filled` and `data-loading` on the root.
`--search-bar-gap`, `-color`, `-placeholder-color`, `-icon-size`, `-icon-color`, `-hover-ring-color`, `-focus-ring-color`, `-focus-glow-color`.

items.note: each header becomes a column: `value` → `key`, `type: { key, params }` → a flat `type` (`string` → none, `number`, `date` or `datetime`, `boolean`, `custom`), `params.nullText` → `empty`, `locked` → `required`, `sortModify` → `sort` with `{ builder, direction }`; `icon` and `checkbox` columns are gone (use a `cell` snippet), `data` is gone

manual.summary: `headers` become `columns`: `value` → `key`, `type: { key, params }` → a flat `type` and options. `string` → `text` (or no type), `number` → `number` (now formatted and right-aligned), `date` with a luxon `format` → `date` or `datetime` with `dateFormat` (Intl options, language from `locale`), `custom` stays `custom`, `icon` and `checkbox` are gone (they ignored the value). `nullText` → `empty` (also when it was a function: use `format` or `cell`), `sortModify` → `sort` with `{ builder, direction }` instead of `{ builder, sortDirection }`, `minWidth`/`maxWidth`/`width` accept any CSS length, `pinned` stays, `locked` and `data` are gone.
manual.action: Rewrite each header object. A `date` column with `{ format: 'dd/MM/yyyy', locale: 'it' }` usually needs no options: the default is day, month and year in digits in the language of `locale`; luxon values still work. Remove `icon` columns or draw the icon with a `cell` snippet. Where a header had `width` in %, keep it: it is a preferred width; use `minWidth` when the column must not shrink.

manual.summary: `customSnippet` (now `cellSnippet`) usually holds a chain `{#if header.value == 'a'} … {:else if header.value == 'b'} …`. It keeps working with `column.key`, but every column can carry its own `cell` snippet, and formatting that v4 apps did by hand is now built in: dates (`type: 'date'`), money (`type: 'number', numberFormat: { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }`), yes/no (`type: 'boolean'`), empty text (`empty`).
manual.action: The codemod renames the parameters (`header` → `column`, `item` → `row`, `header.value` → `.key`). Then, branch by branch, replace hand-made formatting with the column type, and move the remaining branches to top-level snippets referenced by `cell` in the column definition; delete `cellSnippet` when it is empty.

manual.summary: v4 SimpleTable only showed the arrow: the app sorted the items (or the server did). v5 sorts the rows by itself (`sorting="local"`, the default) by the value of the column, or with its `compare(a, b)`.
manual.action: Where `onsort` sorted the items in the app, delete that code and let the table sort. Where the server sorts (the handler reloads the data), add `sorting="manual"` and keep the handler as `onsortchange({ sort })`. Replace `bind:sortedBy` / `bind:sortDirection` with `bind:sort`.

manual.summary: About half of the row click handlers only navigate (`goto('/x/' + item.id)`). `rowHref` makes the row a real link: Ctrl-click and middle click open a new tab, SvelteKit preloads it, keyboard and screen readers reach it.
manual.action: Where `onrowClick` only calls `goto(url)`, replace it with `rowHref={(row) => url}`. Keep `onrowclick` for actions that are not a page (opening a dialog, selecting).

manual.summary: Above 200 rows (`virtualize`) only the rows in view, plus a margin, are in the page; the others are drawn while scrolling and the columns keep the widths of the first rows. The find of the browser (Ctrl+F) and printing see only the drawn rows.
manual.action: Usually nothing to do. Where a page must show every row in the DOM (printing, Ctrl+F on long lists, tests or scripts that query all the rows), pass `virtualize={false}`, or a higher threshold such as `virtualize={1000}`.

manual.summary: Default look changed to the prototype: bordered rounded box, small uppercase grey headers, 9px × 12px cells (v4: 60px rows), monospaced numbers and dates, "—" in empty cells, hover and selected rows tinted; below 640px of width the rows become cards (`cardBreakpoint`).
manual.action: Usually accept it. For the v4 density set `--table-cell-padding`; for blank empty cells pass `empty=""`; to keep the sideways scrolling on phones pass `cardBreakpoint={false}`. App CSS on `.simple-table`, `.item-tr`, `.thead` must target `.aurora-table`, `.aurora-table-row`, `.aurora-table-header` or use the `class` parts.

added: `sorting="manual"`, `onsortchange`, `compare` per column.

`selectable` (`single` / `multiple`, shift-click ranges) with `bind:selected`, `selectedAll`, `excluded`, `onselectionchange`.
`expandedSnippet`, `bind:expanded`, `expandable`, `onexpandedchange`.
`rowHref`, `rowKey`, keyboard support for `onrowclick`.
`virtualize` (only the rows in view above 200 rows, or the given number) and `onendreached` for loading more rows.
`disabled` (read-only table: no row clicks, sorting, selection or resizing) and `selectAll={false}` (multiple selection without "select all").
`actionsVisibility="hover"`: the buttons of `actionsSnippet` show only on hover and focus, as in the prototype.
`bind:columnState`, `oncolumnstatechange`, `columnsKey`; resizing with the keyboard.
Cards below `cardBreakpoint`, `cardTitle`, `cardColumns` (the other columns behind "Show more fields").
`loadingRows`, `caption`, `labels`, `bind:tableElement`, native attributes on the root, `data-cards`, `data-loading`, `data-resizing`, `data-actions-visibility`, `data-selected`, `data-expanded`.

`--table-color`, `-row-background`, `-border`, `-border-radius`, `-font-size`, `-header-color`, `-header-letter-spacing`, `-header-text-transform`, `-header-sorted-color`, `-sort-icon-size`, `-info-icon-size`, `-cell-padding`, `-row-selected-*`, `-number-*`, `-date-*`, `-empty-color`, `-boolean-*`, `-pinned-shadow`, `-actions-*`, `-expand-icon-size`, `-detail-*`, `-footer-*`, `-loading-opacity`, `-resizer-width`, `-card-*`, `-focus-ring-*`, `-duration`, `-easing`.

manual.summary: Typing accepts four digits; a year outside `min` / `max`, or an unfinished one when the field loses focus, shows the error state with `invalidText` ("Enter a valid year", in Italian "Inserisci un anno valido") and makes the form invalid. The value updates on `input` (v4: on keydown after 30ms).
manual.action: Italian apps get the Italian message from `setDefaultLocale("it")` or `locale="it"`; pass `invalidText` only for another message (`invalidText="Anno non valido"`).

manual.summary: The field is 36px high with a border, the calendar button at the start and a chevron at the end, and fills its container (v4: a 280px filled grey SimpleTextField). The years are a 4-column YearSelector in a Menu (desktop) or a bottom Drawer titled `drawerTitle ?? label` (mobile).
manual.action: Set `--year-picker-text-field-width` where the v4 width mattered; pass `label` or `drawerTitle` (`openLabel` and `closeLabel` follow the locale). The menu size is `--year-picker-text-field-menu-width` and `-menu-padding`.

manual.summary: Markup and classes changed: `.year-picker-activator` and the SimpleTextField classes → `.aurora-year-picker-text-field` (`data-state`, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly`, `data-open`), `-label`, `-row`, `-control`, `-hint`; the input is a combobox with a generated id.
manual.action: Rewrite app `:global(...)` selectors that target the v4 markup, or use the `class` parts and the `--year-picker-text-field-*` variables.

added: `label`, `labelSnippet`, `hint`, `hintSnippet`, `state`, `stateIconSnippet`, `invalidText`.
`name` (hidden input with the year), `required`, `readonly`, `id`.
`clearable`, `clearLabel`, `clearSnippet`, `chevronSnippet`.
`drawerTitle`, `closeLabel`, `openLabel`.
`locale` (BCP 47): language of the default texts, Italian with `it`, English otherwise; without it the one of `setDefaultLocale` (step `global-default-locale`), else `en`. Text props win over it.
`bind:input`; native attributes and events of the input; Arrow Down moves the focus into the years.
`--year-picker-text-field-*` variables for the label, field, icons, states, hint and menu.

removed.name: selectableYears
removed.note: The grid shows every year from `min` to `max` (numbers, default 1900–2100; v4 default: the 75 years before and after the current one): `selectableYears={years}` → `min={first} max={last}`. A list with holes has no equivalent.

changed.name: disabled
changed.note: Same meaning; the grid also fades, leaves the Tab order and sets `aria-disabled`.

types.name: class
types.note: `class="x"` → `class={{ container: "x" }}`; `year` goes on each year.

changed.name: onclick
changed.note: `e.detail.year` → `e.year`. If the usage also has `onchange`, merge the two handlers into one.

changed.name: onchange
changed.note: `e.detail.year` → `e.year`. Always a number now: clicking the selected year keeps it (v4 set it to `undefined`), so checks for `undefined` can go.

renamed.note: The parameters change too: see `snippets.parameters`.

removed.name: selectorSnippet
removed.note: It replaced the whole year and had to call `handleYearClick` itself. Use `itemSnippet` for the content (the cell keeps click, keyboard and state) and `--year-selector-*` or `class.year` for the look.

parameters.name: itemSnippet
parameters.v5: { year: number; selected: boolean; current: boolean }

changed.name: --year-selector-height
changed.note: Height of the grid; default `auto` (v4: `100%`). It scrolls past `--year-selector-max-height`.

changed.name: --year-selector-max-height
changed.note: Same meaning; default `240px` (v4: `500px`).

changed.name: --year-selector-width
changed.note: Width of the grid only; v4 also gave it to every year button.

manual.summary: Clicking the selected year keeps it selected; v4 set `selectedYear` to `undefined` (and crashed the v4 DatePicker).
manual.action: Where the app relied on the second click to clear the year, add an explicit clear action that sets `selectedYear = undefined`.

manual.summary: A scrolling grid of 4 columns in the mono font (v4: a vertical list of text Buttons, the selected year bigger and bold); the current year has a border, the selected one a primary fill, and the grid scrolls to it when it appears.
manual.action: Drop `--button-*` variables passed to style the v4 list; use `--year-selector-columns="1"` for a single column, and the other `--year-selector-*` variables for the look.

manual.summary: It is an ARIA listbox: one Tab stop, the arrows move in the grid, Page Up and Page Down jump three rows, Home and End go to the first and last year, Enter and Space choose. v4 had every year as a Button in the Tab order.
manual.action: Give it an accessible name with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` (default "Year"). End-to-end tests should use `getByRole("option", { name: "2026" })`.

manual.summary: Markup and classes changed: `.selector-container` and the wrapped Buttons → `.aurora-year-selector` (`role="listbox"`, it scrolls) and `.aurora-year-selector-year` (`role="option"`) with `[data-selected]` and `[data-current]`.
manual.action: Rewrite app `:global(...)` selectors that target the v4 markup.

added: `min`, `max`.
`locale` (BCP 47): language of the default texts, Italian with `it`, English otherwise; without it the one of `setDefaultLocale` (step `global-default-locale`), else `en`. Text props win over it.
`focus()` method, `bind:yearSelectorElement`, native attributes on the grid.
`data-disabled` on the grid; `data-selected`, `data-current` on the years.
`--year-selector-*` variables for columns, gap, padding, font, colors, selected, current, hover, disabled and focus ring.
